summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology with hands-on experience in CUDA kernel optimization, GPU memory coalescing, and distributed computing on MPI and SLURM clusters. Built custom CUDA kernels that cut inference time by 35% versus a PyTorch baseline and applied 8-bit quantization to shrink LLM memory footprint by 55% with under 1% accuracy loss. Comfortable working the full stack from low-level kernel design to TensorRT-based inference deployment on edge hardware.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% by fine-tuning DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using the HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API; added domain-specific special tokens and resized the decoder embedding layer accordingly.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for edge inference deployment.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Achieved 49.2ms inference versus 73.3ms uncoalesced and 77.5ms CPU TorchScript, a ~35% speedup, via custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing and constant memory for weights and biases.
Achieved 1.5–2× speedup in convolution operations through efficient global memory utilization with identical classification accuracy.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B, with under 1% accuracy degradation across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC benchmarks.
Profiled peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types using pynvml and psutil to evaluate efficiency versus task-performance trade-offs for edge deployment.

projects.name: MPI Hodgkin-Huxley Neuron Simulation
bullets: Achieved up to 10.49× speedup with 12 slave processes on a SLURM-managed cluster by distributing dendrite computations across MPI workers with synchronous soma updates.
Identified load imbalance effects showing up to 65% performance degradation under uneven work distribution; characterized scaling behavior across dendrite counts and compartment depths.

projects.name: Parallel Ray Tracer with MPI Task Scheduling
bullets: Achieved up to 30× speedup with static strip partitioning across 55 processes, benchmarking four parallel work distribution strategies for rendering 5000×5000 pixel scenes with MPI.
Showed dynamic task queue scheduling outperformed all static partitioning methods under unpredictable workloads.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Achieved a 5.2× inference speedup (56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS) via TensorRT-optimized YOLO for visual servoing versus an eager PyTorch baseline.

Built a three-layer distributed pipeline (Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, Jetson+Arduino controller) linked by a unified WebSocket fabric routing voice, vision, and control data in real time.
Resolved 11 integration failures; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.
